args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Bump the pin
to 2.9.4, the patched release.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades the `fastjson` pin in `requirements.txt` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. All versions `< 2.9.4` are affected; `2.9.4` is the patched release. I chose the minimal fix (patch-level bump within the same major version) rather than jumping to the 3.x fix line to limit behavioral risk.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**.
